Intersect strict ranges for higher-priority j and weak ranges for lower-priority j to ensure target wins all comparisons under fixed tie priority. The orthogonal projection P onto this subspace takes any χ with p=<χ|P|χ>>0 to η=Pχ/√p, a valid target-class normalized state with overlap √p. Pullback under U† has source-defined fidelity distance 1-√p. This gives upper bound on the infimum over all target-class witnesses. An independently constructed three-outcome diagonal POVM exhibits a nonempty strict target-safe intersection and the exact p=1/2 measurement overlap. The analytic proof, not the example, handles noncommuting POVMs.
